1_canonical_route_sequences.details: 154 routes, 164 sequence groups, 1,491 route-stop links with strict sequence_order.

2_c5_route_geometry_registry.details: 1,327 inter-stop segments with 100% useful route-shape corridor classification, but not yet wired to backend runtime service.

3_backend_service.details: DeterministicGeometryEngine queries route_intelligence and stops in DB. For non-exact routes, coordinates are returned as empty list [].

4_http_api_contract.details: Returns geometry_status (CORRIDOR/PARTIAL/NONE) and empty coordinates list, without segment-level corridor roads, confidence tiers, or OSM relation IDs.

5_web_map.details: When backend returns empty verified_coordinates, Tier 2 in resolveRouteMapGeometry connects any >=2 geocoded stops with a straight line, even when intermediate stops are unresolved.

6_mobile_map.details: Mobile shared core defines TransitStopSummary and PlacesRepository, but does not yet consume route polyline endpoints.

root_causes: geometry_engine.py only queries DB route_intelligence table and does not read c5_route_geometry.json
transitGeometry.ts has fallback that connects sparse validStops into a polyline across gaps
API lacks segment breakdown and decoupled confidence metadata
